policies.title: Chilean citizens: citizenship entry status
policies.summary: Chile's Foreign Ministry provides Chileans abroad without valid identity documents a safe-conduct document to travel to Chile. An ordinary Chilean passport therefore represents citizenship, not a foreign visitor-visa route.
conditions: This is supported by the Foreign Ministry's direct Chilean return-document route, rather than inferred solely from matching catalog codes.
It does not determine treatment of a dual national presenting a different passport, an individual document-validity issue, departure controls, or any foreign visitor status.

unresolved.reason: The current Chilean schedule says Chile does not recognize Kosovo as a subject of international law. That statement does not establish treatment of this catalog's ordinary Kosovo-passport document, and must not be converted to visa_required or another available status.
